steps.text: Search a marshy jungle vine south of Tai Bwo Wannai for some snake weed. If you want to do Zogre Flesh Eaters or Legends' Quest grab one for each as you will need them later.
Search the palm trees north east of Tai Bwo Wannai for an Ardrigal herb. If you want to do Legends' Quest grab one extra as you will need it later.
Search the scorched earth in the south of Tai Bwo Wannai for a Sito Foil herb.
Search the rock for a Volencia Moss herb at the mine south east of Tai Bwo Wannai. If you plan on doing Fairy Tale I then take an extra.
Enter the cave to the north by clicking on the rocks.
Get the Rogues Purse from the fungus covered wall in the underground dungeon. If you are planning on doing Zogre Flesh Eaters then take an extra.
